correctness.rationale: Transform x,y to z=1-x, u=ay/(1-b), gamma=1-b. Exact updates z_next=z(1-gamma*u), u_next=u(1-gamma*z) preserve u-z=tau/N. For each v=z or u the reciprocal w=1/v obeys exact w_{k+1}=w_k/s+gamma/s²+gamma²/[s³ w_k(1-gamma/(s w_k))], s=1-gamma*sigma/N. Uniform positivity and c(k+1)<=w_k<=C(k+1), all k<=N imply w_k=gamma*k+O(1+k²/N+log(k+1)) and 1/w_k=1/(gamma*k)+O(1/N+(1+log k)/k²). The weighted residual sum has coefficient gamma*exp(gamma*sigma*t)*log N+O(1) uniformly sigma in bounded [-R,R], t in [delta,1]; leading linear recurrence equals N*(exp(gamma*sigma*t)-1)/sigma+O(1). Both reciprocal laws follow for sigma=+tau,-tau, including tau=0 continuous extension. Independent computation of exact invariant and N=20k versus 80k residual ratio matches the coefficient (for example gamma=0.6,tau=1.2,t=0.5). This is not a statement for t approaching zero or parameter boundaries.
